role: Code-signing entitlements of the iOS app target.
toplevel: Grants HealthKit, HealthKit background delivery, App Group group.com.chrissharp.flowrecovery (used by AppConfig.appGroupIdentifier, Emuqu/Sources/Utilities/Constants.swift:9, for archive/raw-RR/crash/breadcrumb/feedback containers and the UnitsPreference suite), and iCloud CloudKit container iCloud.com.chrissharp.flowrecovery (Constants.swift:12). Comment (lines 3-10) says both identifiers predate the Emuqu rename and must never change because they address live user data. No aps-environment (no push / CloudKit subscriptions; grep finds no CKSubscription or registerForRemoteNotifications), no ubiquity-kvstore-identifier (EntitlementAnchor.swift:20-24 deliberately uses Keychain instead of NSUbiquitousKeyValueStore), no keychain-access-groups.

flags.text: The comment says the App Group 'holds the shared archive the widget and the app both read', but the project has no widget target (pbxproj targets list 3600-3605) and no Swift file imports WidgetKit or defines WidgetDataPublisher (referenced only by EmuquUITests/WidgetIntegrationUITests.swift and a DataPurgeService comment). Only the app itself uses the group.
